paragraphs.text: And in the third week of this jubilee the unclean demons began to lead astray the the sons of Noah, and to make to err and destroy them. And the sons of Noah came to Noah their father, and they told him concerning the demons which were leading astray and slaying his sons' sons.
paragraphs.original: ወበካልእ፡ ሰቡዕ፡ ለዝንቱ፡ ኢዮቤልዉ፡ አኀዙ፡ ርኩሳን፡ መናፍስት፡ ያስሕትዎሙ፡ ለደቂቀ፡ ደቂቀ፡ ኖኅ፡ ወይትዐርጉ፡ ላዕሌሆሙ፡ ወያስሕትዎሙ፡

paragraphs.text: And he prayed before the Lord his God, and said: 'God of the spirits of all flesh, who hast shown mercy unto me And hast saved me and my sons from the waters of the flood, And hast not caused me to perish as Thou didst the sons of perdition; For Thy grace has been great towards me, And great has been Thy mercy to my soul; Let Thy grace be lift up upon my sons, And let not wicked spirits rule over them Lest they should destroy them from the earth.
paragraphs.original: ወመጽኡ፡ ኀበ፡ ኖኅ፡ አቡሆሙ፡ ወዜነውዎ፡ በእንተ፡ መናፍስት፡ እለ፡ ያስሕትዎሙ፡ ወያዕውርዎሙ፡ ወይቀትልዎሙ፡ ለደቂቀ፡ ደቂቆሙ፡
paragraphs.translit: wamaṣʾu ḫaba noḫ ʾabuhomu wazēnawwo baʾənta manāfsət ʾəla yāsḥətwomu wayāʿwərwomu wayqatəlwomu ladaqiqa daqiqomu

paragraphs.text: But do Thou bless me and my sons, that we may increase and Multiply and replenish the And Thou knowest how Thy Watchers, the fathers of these spirits, acted in my day: and as for these spirits which are living, imprison them and hold them fast in the place of condemnation, and let them not bring destruction on the sons of thy servant, my God; for these are malignant, and created in order to destroy.

paragraphs.text: And let them not rule over the spirits of the living; for Thou alone canst exercise dominion over them. And let them not have power over the sons of the from henceforth and for evermore.' And the Lord our God bade us to bind all.

paragraphs.text: the chief of the spirits, Mastêmâ, came and said: 'Lord, Creator, let some of them remain before me, and let them harken to my voice, and do all that I shall say unto them; for if some of them are not left to me, I shall not be able to execute the power of my will on the sons of men; for these are for corruption and leading astray before my judgment, for great is the wickedness of the sons of And He said: Let the tenth part of them remain before him, and let nine parts descend place of condemnation.'

paragraphs.text: And one of us He commanded that we should teach Noah all medicines; for He knew that they would not walk in uprightness, nor strive in And we did according to all His words: all the malignant evil ones we bound in the place of condemnation and a tenth part of them we left that they might be subject before Satan on the And we explained to Noah all the medicines of their diseases, together with their seductions, how he might heal them with herbs of the earth.

paragraphs.text: And Noah slept with his fathers, and was Mount Lubar in the land of Ararat. Nine hundred and fifty years he completed in his jubilees and two weeks and five years. [1659 A.M.] And in his life on earth he excelled the children of men save Enoch because of the righteousness, wherein he was perfect. For Enoch's office was ordained for a testimony to the generations of the world, so that he should recount all the deeds of generation unto generation, till the day of judgment.

paragraphs.text: And in the three and thirtieth jubilee, in the first year in the second week, Peleg took to himself a wife, whose name was Lomna the daughter of Sina'ar, and she bare him a son in the fourth year of this week, and he called his name Reu; for he said: 'Behold the children of men have become evil through the wicked purpose of building for a city and a tower in the land of Shinar.'
paragraphs.original: ወይቤ፡ ዘዘ፡ ዐሥሮሙ፡ የሐድጉ፡ ቦቱ፡ ቅድሜሁ፡ ወዘዘ፡ ተስዐሙ፡ ያውርዱ፡ ውስተ፡ መካን፡ ኩናኔ፡

paragraphs.text: And the Lord descended, and we descended with him to city and the tower which the children of men had built. In the fourth week in the first year [1688 A.M.] in the beginning thereof in the four and thirtieth jubilee, were they dispersed from the land of Shinar.

paragraphs.text: And Ham and his sons went into the land which he was to occupy, which he acquired in the land of the south. paragraphs.text: Cursed art thou, and cursed shalt thou be beyond all the sons of Noah, by the curse by which we bound ourselves by an oath in the presence of the holy judge, and in the presence of Noah our But he did not harken unto them, and dwelt in the land of Lebanon from Hamath to the Egypt, he and his sons until this day.

paragraphs.text: And for this reason that land is named And Japheth and his sons went towards the sea and dwelt in the land of their portion, and Madai saw the land of the sea and it did not please him, and he begged a (portion) from Ham and Asshur and Arpachshad, his wife's brother, and he dwelt in the land of Media, near to his wife's brother until And he called his dwelling-place, and the dwelling-place of his sons, Media, after the name of their father Madai.
